name: Electrical Bid Manager (Vision InfoSoft)
summary: A mid-size electrical estimating program with on-screen takeoff and QuickBooks job costing.
differentiator: A 10,000-item library with a stated starting cost ("less than $1,000/year"), while the weekly material price updates are a separate subscription with no price given.
pricing: Vendor says "Get started for less than $1,000/year." No exact plan price.

scope.takeoff: Electronic on-screen takeoff with modules for branch circuits, lighting and wiring devices.
scope.library: Over 10,000 items and assemblies. Each item has 3 columns of labor units.
scope.laborUnits: Three labor-unit columns per item. The source of the units is not stated.

materialPrices.note: Weekly updates come through EPIC Pricing with NetPricer. The vendor offers the update service "at subscription frequencies that fit your needs" and gives no price.

bestFor: Small commercial and service shops that want job costing synced to QuickBooks.
skipIf: You want a counted assembly library in the hundreds of thousands.
watchOut: The yearly figure is a starting point. The price-update subscription is extra.
